name: Enter Sempiternity
source:
An idea born of the Noise Jam 4 prompt "A Girl-Shaped Hole", evolved into something much more than planned, and much broader. Walk the path and reflect on how it makes you feel, find your own meaning in that reflection, or simply enjoy the abyssal stroll.

[From [url=https://zilluzion.itch.io/enter-sempiternity]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本作灵感源自Noise Jam 4创作大赛的主题“少女形状的空洞”，最终演化成了一部远超原定构想、格局更为宏阔的作品。踏上这条旅途，细细体味它带给你的感受，在沉思中寻觅属于你自己的意义，又或者单纯享受这场漫步深渊的旅程吧。

[摘自[url=https://zilluzion.itch.io/enter-sempiternity]itch.io[/url]]
